audit.whatIsWrong: Three rows disagreed with the packet chart and with the mirror: Level 1 and First item read Skill, and 2+ items read Graves.
audit.why: Packet chart on 30 games is Graves, Graves, Graves, Graves, Ziggs, Graves, Ziggs, and the mirror set all seven of its rows to exactly that. Level 6 and 2+ items are the only two rows you own — the ones where Mega Inferno Bomb and artillery range beat his 1000-range R.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 4, 5 and 6 flipped on both layers as one atomic group, with ratings adjusted to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere, and the first-item row was written as your Blackfire Torch spike on a row that belongs to Graves.
audit.why: End of the Line is 13s down to 6s at 925 range; Smoke Screen 26/24/22/20/18s at 950; Quickdraw 16s to 12s at 425 and its cooldown drops every time he lands an auto; Collateral Damage 100/80/60s at 1000. Your Satchel Charge is 20s at rank 1, Hexplosive Minefield a flat 16s.
audit.corrected: First item now names his spike, and Satchel Charge's 20s is quoted where the advice depends on it.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page called his Q 'Buckshot', credited his passive with armour stacks, described Smoke Screen as a blind, and claimed your Q out-ranges him.
audit.why: His Q is End of the Line, and at 925 it out-ranges Bouncing Bomb's 850 — the reverse of the tldr's claim. New Destiny is the shotgun: four bullets that cannot pass through units, plus the reload, which is why standing behind the minion wave blanks most of his damage. The armour and MR come from Quickdraw's True Grit, refreshed by his autos, not from the passive. Smoke Screen reduces sight range and slows on impact; it blinds nothing and stops neither your abilities nor your autos.
audit.corrected: Correct names throughout, the real source of his armour, the true nature of Smoke Screen, and the minion-block property of his shotgun.

notes: 'Buckshot' is a fabricated ability name — his Q is End of the Line — and it appeared in five separate fields. The 'smoke-screen blind' claim is the same invention the mirror flagged as the most dangerous sentence on the Graves page.
